finding.expected: Reuse the existing canonical RUN/RESULT/EVIDENCE validation boundary (or an exactly equivalent existing helper) so the requested run_id, TASK revision, candidate SHA, ResultPackage claims/evidence, and evidence run_id/subject_sha are all bound before validate_review is allowed to canonicalize a decision.
finding.issue: SUBMIT_REVIEW does not fully bind the canonical RUN, ResultPackage, and EVIDENCE lineage before accepting a semantic REVIEW. It parses run.json only far enough to extract task_id, validates only result.json.result with validate_result, and checks result.head_sha against the candidate, while ignoring canonical evidence binding and the exact RUN identity/revision/executor/base relationship. The existing canonical validate_result_package boundary performs those bindings, so malformed or mismatched artifact identity can reach review validation instead of failing closed.
